{
  "name": "hal-session-auto-rename",
  "displayName": "HAL Session Auto-rename",
  "version": "2.0.2",
  "description": "Automatically name each session and rename it as the conversation evolves",
  "author": {
    "name": "Vinta Chen",
    "email": "vinta.chen@gmail.com"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/vinta/hal-9000",
  "homepage": "https://vinta.ws/code/",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/vinta/hal-9000/blob/main/plugins/hal-session-auto-rename/README.md",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/vinta/hal-9000/issues",
  "license": "MIT",
  "icon": "./icon.png",
  "keywords": [
    "session",
    "session-title",
    "auto-rename",
    "title",
    "ai-title",
    "hooks",
    "mods"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Model",
      "description": "claude/haiku runs on your Claude account; ollama/gemma4:31b-mlx runs on a local Ollama at localhost:11434.",
      "options": [
        "claude/haiku",
        "ollama/gemma4:31b-mlx"
      ],
      "default": "claude/haiku"
    },
    "refreshEveryNTurns": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Refresh every N turns",
      "description": "Regenerate the session title every N turns. 0 keeps the first title.",
      "default": 5
    }
  }
}
